Name: Desaturated Sunberry Village
Author: itstern
Description:
This mod uniformly desaturates all [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] assets for a softer look and better compatibility with popular recolors. Every asset, from portraits to items to maps and more, is desaturated. Other mods that edit SBV's assets will take priority over this one, so you can mix and match. Think of this mod as a catch-all for anything that isn't affected by another recolor mod. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLgTcMBt/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Should be compatible with all mods, including major expansions. 

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can turn desaturation on or off for individual characters' sprites or portraits, as well as for broad categories (like Maps, Crops/forage, etc.).

This was specifically made to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/herbivoor?gameId=1303]Herbivoor[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url] (significant preset). I recommend using both!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjYhfz5/troubleshooting.png[/img]

By default, most character portraits/sprites are turned [b]off[/b]. SBV tends to use more natural looking colors, and when characters are desaturated as much as the rest of the mod, they look more washed out than most people would probably like. Only non-humanoid characters are turned on by default. You can toggle individual characters' portraits/sprites on in the config menu. Please also note that character skin tones will stay the same as they appear in the original mod.

No known issues right now, but please let me know if anything comes up!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0Q5sgrsb/my-mods.png[/img]﻿
